title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
summary: Paul Christiano, an influential AI researcher focused on alignment, is joining the OpenAI Foundation as a member of its board.
reason: A board-of-directors appointment is a governance/personnel change, not a new model, research paper, financing/M&A/partnership/product launch/market data, policy action, or open-source tool release. No active rule covers it.
